svg.title: The five line sensors
svg.desc: Robot photograph © Pololu Corporation — pololu.com. Branded instructional graphic showing the five downward-facing line sensors on the underside of the Zumo 32U4. The authentic transparent PNG bottom-view photograph is embedded byte-for-byte and has not been cropped, resampled, recompressed, or redrawn. The outer pair, sensors [0] and [4], are emphasized as intersection watchers; the middle trio, sensors [1], [2], and [3], are used for line-position control.
svg.text: Outer pair [0] and [4]: the intersection watchers

g.text: They ride beside the line — where the markers are.
They straddle the line and steer Lesson 8’s P-control.
